subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository trust and land all 13 upgraded action pins together on head `30081f9ea92df5f0d656882ebf5fe74c5977ee56` after exact-head checks complete?
rationale: These immutable-pin changes are mechanically correct, but they replace executable third-party code in secret-bearing, security-scanning, release, and agent workflows; repository owners must approve that trust decision.

options.title: Approve the stable bundle
options.body: Review the upstream releases and exact SHAs, wait for required checks on the unchanged head, then approve the grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate Codex, token, registry, release, and security-scanning actions into smaller PRs when owners cannot confidently review the bundle as one trust change.

options.title: Pause for stable automation
options.body: Leave the PR open until Dependabot repository access and repeated rebasing stop producing moving heads.

recommendation.title: Approve the stable bundle
recommendation.body: Review the upstream releases and exact SHAs, wait for required checks on the unchanged head, then approve the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans the affected CI, Codex-agent, and release workflow surfaces.
